name: git-exclude-backup
description: Back up private files in Git repos to GitHub.
author: capsudo

commands.title: Git Exclude Backup: Show Loaded Message

gitExcludeBackup.backupRepositoryName.description: GitHub repository name used to store excluded-file backups.

gitExcludeBackup.backupBranch.description: Branch used in the GitHub backup repository.

gitExcludeBackup.extraBackupIgnoreGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns for excluded files that should not be backed up.

gitExcludeBackup.backupAfterDetectedPush.description: Run backup after VS Code Git status suggests a push completed.

gitExcludeBackup.decorateExplorer.description: Show explorer badges for excluded-file backup status.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check src/constants.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/file-decoration-provider.js && node --check src/helpers.js && node --check src/workspace-state.js && node --check scripts/test-workspace-state.js
